follow-up time: Until menstrual recovery after pregnancy termination
cohort: Patients with previous caesarean delivery (CD) diagnosed with placenta previa status and placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent pregnancy termination in the second trimester at Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital between June 2013 and December 2018 (n = 51)
finding: This study found significant differences in gestational weeks at termination, type of placenta previa status, main operative success rate, and β-HCG regression time among three different pregnancy termination strategies in patients with previous CD and diagnosed with placenta previa status and PAS.
